name: otrion-remote-ssh
description: Open remote folders in Otrion over SSH.

otrion.ssh.path.description: An absolute path to the SSH executable. When empty, it will use "ssh" on the path or in common install locations.

otrion.ssh.configFile.description: The absolute file path to a custom SSH config file.

otrion.ssh.connectionBackend.description: Select the backend used for SSH connections. The native backend is additive and intentionally left opt-in.
enumDescriptions: Use the existing ssh2 js library backend.

otrion.ssh.connectTimeout.description: Specifies the timeout in seconds used for the SSH command that connects to the remote.

enumDescriptions: Add the key to known_hosts and connect, like OpenSSH's `accept-new`.
Show the key fingerprint and ask before connecting.
otrion.ssh.verifyUnknownHosts.description: What to do when a host is not present in known_hosts.

enumDescriptions: Connect without asking. The recorded key is left untouched.
Show both fingerprints and ask before connecting.
otrion.ssh.verifyKnownHosts.description: What to do when a host presents a different key than the one recorded in known_hosts. A changed host key can mean the server was reinstalled — or that the connection is being intercepted.

otrion.ssh.defaultExtensions.description: List of extensions that should be installed automatically on all SSH hosts.

otrion.ssh.enableDynamicForwarding.description: Whether to use SSH dynamic forwarding to allow setting up new port tunnels over an existing SSH connection.

otrion.ssh.enableAgentForwarding.markdownDescription: Enable fixing the remote environment so that the SSH config option `ForwardAgent` will take effect as expected from Otrion's remote extension host.

otrion.ssh.serverDownloadUrlTemplate.description:
The URL from where the Otrion server will be downloaded. You can use the following variables and they will be replaced dynamically:
- ${quality}: server quality, e.g. stable or insiders
- ${version}: server version, e.g. 1.69.0
- ${commit}: server release commit
- ${arch}: server architecture, e.g. x64, armhf, arm64
- ${release}: release number, vscodium only https://github.com/VSCodium/vscodium/pull/1192

otrion.ssh.remotePlatform.description: A map of the remote hostname to the platform for that remote. Valid values: linux, macos, windows.

otrion.ssh.remoteServerListenOnSocket.description: When true, the remote Otrion server will listen on a socket path instead of opening a port. Only valid for Linux and macOS remotes. Requires `AllowStreamLocalForwarding` to be enabled for the SSH server.

otrion.ssh.serverInstallPath.description: Specifies custom installation directories for the Otrion server on remote hosts. Maps each remote hostname (or pattern) to an absolute path where the server should be installed. Supports wildcards: use `*` for catch-all, or `*.domain.com` for domain-specific paths. More specific patterns take precedence over general ones. When not specified, the server installs in the default home directory. **Note**: Changing this setting may require manual cleanup of existing server installations in previous locations.

otrion.ssh.serverBinaryName.description: The name of the server binary, use this **only if** you are using a client without a corresponding server release

otrion.ssh.serverVersion.description: The version number of the remote VSCodium server. Can take the values: 'match' (default), 'latest', 'closest' or a specific version (e.g. '1.117.0').

otrion.ssh.serverValidation.description: Type of server validation: 'strict' (default) enforces that the remote and local server are the same version by matching the commit, 'force' modifies the remote commit to match the local server, 'skip' skips validation all together.
enumDescriptions: Modify the commit of the remote server.
The remote server won't validate the client.
The remote server and client's commits must match. (default)

otrion.ssh.localServerDownload.description:
Whether the extension can download the Otrion server on the client and transfer it to the host with scp, instead of downloading it on the host.
- auto: The server will first be downloaded on the host, and if that fails, will fall back to downloading locally
- always: The server will only be downloaded locally and transferred to the host
- off: The server will only be downloaded on the host
enumDescriptions: The server will first be downloaded on the host, and if that fails, will fall back to downloading locally
The server will only be downloaded locally and transferred to the host
The server will only be downloaded on the host
